source_quote: Administration (CBA) at Rafik Hariri University was established in 1999. Since then, the
answer: The CBA, RHU's first and oldest college, was established in 1999. It offers six undergraduate business programs and a graduate MBA in general business administration, and was the first in Lebanon and the Arab world to offer an MBA in Oil and Gas Management.

source_quote: In 2019, the CBA became the first Lebanese university to earn full ACBSP accreditation
answer: In 2019 the CBA became the first Lebanese university to earn full ACBSP accreditation for all its degrees and programs.

source_quote: Finally, the CBA distinguishes itself by its systematic Co-op Work Experience program,
answer: The CBA is distinguished by its systematic Co-op Work Experience program and its Community Engagement Experience program, which builds leadership through community service.

source_quote: The College of Business Administration aims to become the region's premier institution
answer: CBA vision: to become the region's premier institution for innovative business education. Mission: transform students' lives through graduate and undergraduate business education, advance knowledge through applied research, and positively impact society, developing ethical and socially responsible leaders.

source_quote: Academic Freedom of Inquiry
answer: CBA core values: Academic Freedom of Inquiry; Excellence through Innovation; Ethical and Socially Responsible Conduct; Tolerance and Diversity; Personal Initiative and Individual Responsibility; Teamwork, Collaboration and Cooperation; Continuous Improvement and Innovation.

source_quote: Knowledge of the main Students will acquire basic knowledge of the main
answer: CBA learning goals: knowledge of the main business functional areas (CLG1), specialized knowledge (CLG2), effective communication (CLG3), analysis and critical thinking (CLG4), and ethical and socially responsible conduct (CLG5).

source_quote: The College of Business Administration offers six undergraduate programs leading to a
answer: The CBA offers six BBA programs (Accounting, Business IT Management, Finance and Banking, Human Resources Management, Management, Marketing and Advertising), two minors (Business Administration, Human Resources Management), and two MBAs (General Business Management, Oil and Gas Management).

source_quote: BHRM Human Resources Management
answer: CBA course prefixes: BACC Accounting, BFIN Finance and Banking, BADM General Business Administration, BECN Economics, BITM Business IT Management, BMGT Management, BHRM Human Resources Management, BMKA Marketing and Advertising.

source_quote: one of the business majors may be required to take a mathematics placement
answer: Besides University admission requirements, business applicants may have to take a mathematics placement exam depending on their Lebanese Baccalaureate math score; those who fail must pass one or two related courses.

source_quote: Each Business program awards a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) degree,
answer: Each business program awards a BBA of 99 credits split into University, College and Program requirements; University and College requirements are common to all CBA programs (30 gen-ed, 41 college, 28 program credits).

source_quote: BBA in Accounting (99 Credits)
answer: BBA in Accounting (99 credits): General Education 30 (30%), College Requirements 41 (41%), Program Requirements 28 (28%); major 31 mandatory + 3 elective, non-major 53 mandatory + 12 elective.

source_quote: BBA in Business IT Management (99 Credits)
answer: BBA in Business IT Management (99 credits): General Education 30, College Requirements 41, Program Requirements 28; major 31 mandatory + 3 elective, non-major 53 mandatory + 12 elective.

source_quote: BBA in Finance and Banking (99 Credits)
answer: BBA in Finance and Banking (99 credits): General Education 30, College Requirements 41, Program Requirements 28; major 28 mandatory + 3 elective, non-major 56 mandatory + 12 elective.

answer: BBA in Human Resources Management (99 credits): General Education 30, College Requirements 41, Program Requirements 28; major 25 mandatory + 3 elective, non-major 59 mandatory + 12 elective.

source_quote: BBA in Management (99 Credits)
answer: BBA in Management (99 credits): General Education 30, College Requirements 41, Program Requirements 28; major 28 mandatory + 3 elective, non-major 56 mandatory + 12 elective.

source_quote: BBA in Marketing and Advertising (99 Credits)
answer: BBA in Marketing and Advertising (99 credits): General Education 30, College Requirements 41, Program Requirements 28; major 28 mandatory + 3 elective, non-major 56 mandatory + 12 elective.

source_quote: A business student in any of the programs is eligible for graduation if s/he has:
answer: A business student can graduate after completing all degree requirements, with a cumulative GPA of 70%+, a major GPA of 70%+, at least 70% in BADM 490, and completion of the mandatory Co-op Work Experience and Community Engagement Experience.

source_quote: Every student is required to take 30 credit hours of general education courses distributed
answer: Business students take 30 gen-ed credits (18 mandatory, 12 elective): Communication 8 (ENGL 210, ENGL 217, ARAB 212); Humanities/Fine Arts 3-6 and Social Sciences/Culture 6 from approved lists; Natural Sciences and Technology 6 (one natural science course + BITM 200); Quantitative Reasoning 3 (BADM 225 Business Math); Community and Sustainability 4 (BADM 355 + one 1-credit course).

source_quote: a substitute for ARAB 212.
answer: Non-native speakers of Arabic in the business college may take SOCI 310 or CMNS 410 instead of ARAB 212.

source_quote: Linear equations, supply and demand analysis, non-linear equations, quadratic
answer: BADM 225 Business Math, 3(3,0): linear and non-linear equations, supply and demand, exponential and log functions, compound interest, investment appraisal, derivatives and marginal analysis, elasticity, optimization, integration, matrices and Cramer's rule.

source_quote: This course is an introduction to the general and business use of computers. It covers
answer: In the CBA section, BITM 200 Information Technology Essentials, 3(3,0), introduces general and business computer use: hardware, operating systems, the internet and software, with emphasis on MS Office.

source_quote: papers, and oral presentations. Prerequisite: ENGL 101 or TOEFL 550+ (paper) or
answer: In the CBA section, the prerequisite for ENGL 210 is listed as ENGL 101 or TOEFL 550+ (paper) or 100+ (computer).
review_note: CBA listing (p.203) says TOEFL 100+ (computer) while other listings (p.91, p.115, p.127) say 80+.

source_quote: This remedial course does not count toward fulfilling the degree
answer: English proficiency is required for admission to any CBA program; students may need a remedial mathematics course based on the placement exam or Baccalaureate math score, and it does not count toward degree requirements.
